proof_availability.classification_scope: The proposed product-rooted PNA carrier separates growth, electrophile removal, product reading and reactivation/reset. Polymerase recognition, PCR copying or displacement alone does not establish an autonomous junction-specific bond checkpoint. In the stated renewal model P_step=p*v/(p+w+h*alpha), h=1-p-w, only if every harmless failure returns the same parent. Repeated whole-chain displacement costs b*L*(L+1)/2 nucleotide incorporations before local reading; bounded local cassettes could make that count linear only with actual stopping/reset operations.
